global: light orchestral with pizzicato, chiptune bleeps and analog synth

sections.name: hook
sections.style: cheeky bouncy pizzicato with a retro 8-bit synth riff, a cartoon whoosh energy, then a comic deadpan stop

sections.name: setting
sections.style: smooth airy jet-age lounge groove, soft brushed drums, vibraphone, then a dusty old-machine hum with chunky 80s synth bass

sections.name: rising
sections.style: busy comedic tension, ticking pizzicato ostinato, marimba runs, quirky bassoon, getting more absurd

sections.name: snap
sections.style: comic build to a cartoon brass stab, then a tiny sad trombone plunk

sections.name: deadpan
sections.style: sparse deadpan comic plunks, a lonely retro synth beep phrase, quiet

sections.name: highway
sections.style: frantic comic chase, galloping strings and snare, slapstick pit-stop energy, honky brass

sections.name: announce
sections.style: triumphant playful fanfare, bright brass and glockenspiel, modern upbeat pop-orchestral groove, optimistic

sections.name: finale
sections.style: warm gentle wistful ending, soft retro synth pad and music box, sweet, then a tiny comic 8-bit plink button
